meta.name: babysit
meta.description: Watch a pull request or review cycle until it is ready to merge. Use when asked to babysit, monitor, or keep checking PR comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 持续监控 PR 直到所有问题解决可合并
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要盯着 PR 等待审核通过或 CI 通过
copy.tagline_en: Monitor pull requests until all issues are resolved and ready to merge
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to watch PRs until reviews and CI pass

howto.what: Claude 会持续守着一个拉取请求(PR)直到它达到可合并状态:反复查看 CI 检查、新评论和未解决的评审线程;确有真问题的就提交修复、重跑检查,确认后才关闭过期线程,最后汇报证据。
howto.when: 当你说要 babysit、monitor 某个 PR,或要求持续检查它的评论、评审和 CI 直到所有可处理问题都解决时触发。

say.text: 看着这个 PR #123,CI 挂了或有新意见就处理掉。
say.note: 它会持续轮询并处理失败检查与评论。

say.text: 帮我把 #456 的评审线程都过一遍,修完再回来。
say.note: 会读取未解决线程,针对真问题提交修复。

say.text: 盯着 #789,确认它能合并再汇报。
say.note: 结束前会做一次全新检查并报告证据。

howto.what_en: Claude keeps watching a pull request until it is mergeable: it checks CI, comments and unresolved review threads, fixes real issues, reruns checks, resolves stale threads after verification, then reports evidence.
howto.when_en: Triggered when asked to babysit or monitor a pull request, or to keep checking its comments, review threads, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

say_en.text: Watch PR #123; handle failing CI or new comments as they come.
say_en.note: It will poll and act until the PR is clean.

say_en.text: Go through all review threads on #456 and fix them before reporting back.
say_en.note: It reads threads and commits fixes for real issues.

say_en.text: Watch #789 and report only once it can merge.
say_en.note: Does a fresh final sweep then reports evidence.
